title: Peahat from Zelda: The Wind Waker
description: This datapack adds Peahats from Zelda, with custom AI. No resource pack required!
body:
# Peahat
Peahats can be manually summoned on your map or server with **/function peahat:peahat** (they won't despawn), but they also spawn naturally in forests & despawn after some times!

## Mob features

- Is invulnerable to swords because of its propeller
- Can be defeated with a bow, a single arrow is enough
- Will follow you in a 15 blocks radius
- Custom 3D model & animation, no resource pack required
